experiment: P5c frozen bounded-JNR attachment parameter-OOD atlas
research_question: What is the 30-to-50 dB extrapolation boundary of the P5b4 frozen JNR-only attachment, separate from its confirmed 10-30 dB in-range evidence?

metrics.primary: per-target oracle-gated and predicted-gated NMAE delta to frozen P4c at every power
metrics.secondary: identity-clustered bootstrap CI; 30 dB anchor; per-combination worst deltas
metrics.interpretation: 30 dB is in-range anchor; 35-50 dB are parameter OOD and cannot be pooled into an in-range success claim

stop_rule: No P5c outcome authorizes OOD retraining or a new deeper JNR expert. A negative OOD result is an extrapolation boundary, not a prompt to tune on P5c.
